stem.text: The diagrams all show a pair of equal forces acting on a metre rule.
Which diagram shows forces that provide a couple and zero resultant force?

A.alt: Horizontal rule with two parallel downward arrows at its ends

B.alt: Horizontal rule with an upward arrow at its middle and a downward arrow at one end

C.alt: Horizontal rule with an upward arrow and a downward arrow in line with each other at one end

D.alt: Horizontal rule with an upward arrow at its left end and a diagonal arrow at its right end
